goal: Route PR CI through Manifest V2 gate_profile so only relevant runners execute while deep/frozen-core changes remain fail-closed

guide_delta.summary: Vor einem PR wird zuerst nur der kleine Laufzettel geprüft. Danach starten ausschließlich die für diese Änderungsart nötigen Prüfungen; besonders geschützte Kernbereiche erzwingen weiterhin automatisch die tiefste Prüfung.

direct_dependencies: existing Targeted Iteration, Agent Governance and Repository Foundation gates
tests_required: router validates Manifest V2 before routing
router validates actual PR diff against write_files
scope/docs skip unrelated runners when no targeted work exists
governance runs governance and optional targeted work only
deep runs targeted, governance and foundation
GitHub workflow parsing and triggered I52 gates
tests_explicitly_not_run: full product suite because product code is untouched
TUI/browser/database regressions because runtime and frozen core are untouched
visual evidence because no UI changes exist
risks: GitHub reusable-workflow routing becomes a critical governance boundary and must fail closed before downstream jobs
direct pushes outside the PR discipline no longer receive these three automatic branch workflows; repository development policy already requires small PRs
protected-path detection intentionally covers domain, storage and CatalogService; additional frozen paths must be added when future checkpoints freeze them
non_changes: no EntryFieldWriteAdapter work; that remains I53
expected_side_effects: every PR receives one lightweight route/scope check
scope/docs profiles with empty ci targets do not allocate Targeted, Governance or Foundation runners
deep profile allocates all three downstream gates
profile downgrades and protected frozen-core writes fail before downstream CI
